thunder_cls_roster.why: Waiv average THUNDER classification over 16 datasets (the THUNDER paper's 12 + the 4 SPIDER organ subsets, which postdate that paper). Averaging over 12 while comparing to their 16-set figures is a roster mismatch that biases every pct_of_waiv numerator.
thunder_cls_roster.seed_floor_caveat: THUNDER_FLOOR / THUNDER_SEED_SD were measured on the 12-dataset task mean (n=5 seeds).  A 16-dataset mean is LESS noisy, so reusing the 12ds SD OVER-states the error bar -- the safe direction.  No 5-seed SPIDER cohort exists to remeasure with, so it is reused, not rescaled.
thunder_cls_roster.segmentation: still 0/4 -- no SPIDER segmentation task exists and the two segpath cells are not run on this cohort.  'THUNDER' in this report means CLASSIFICATION ONLY.

criterion.cap_is_presentation_only: F-C (2026-08-26): the 100 cap no longer enters ANY arithmetic.  The >=70 per-cell test, the benchmark means, the overall average and the worst-cell search all run on the UNCAPPED pct_of_waiv.  pct_capped is printed beside it so the old convention stays legible.

sources.aggregation: eval_common.pool_cells -- RATIO OF MEANS: aggregate the numerator (our raw delta) and the denominator (Waiv's raw gain) over the group, then divide ONCE.  Per-cell percentages are never averaged.  Applied at both levels: 3 tasks -> backbone/THUNDER, 3 backbones -> benchmark.
sources.pooling_completeness: all-or-nothing: a pooled number requires EVERY cell of its group; a subset is withheld
sources.denominator_gate: eval_common.pooled_denominator_unresolvable, applied to the POOLED denominator (not per cell): |pooled waiv gain| > 2 * SD(pooled waiv gain) -- the denominator's sign/scale must be determined for the ratio to be a measurement
sources.denominator_gate_change_2026_08_26: F-P: the per-cell 'one seed-SD > 10 pct_of_waiv points' veto is RETIRED as a gate and kept as a diagnostic. It was a PRECISION test (is Waiv's gain known to better than +/-20% relative), not the is-the-denominator-real test its own docstring described, and it rejected cells whose denominators are unambiguously real -- phikon/knn's Waiv gain is 5.8 seed-SD. Denominator imprecision is now PROPAGATED into the interval (delta method on both terms) instead of vetoing the cell.

per_model_criterion: THE CRITERION.  Each backbone independently: pct_of_waiv >= 70 on EACH of RI/HEST/THUNDER AND the mean of its three percentages > 80.  No pooling across backbones.
pooled_across_backbones_NOT_THE_CRITERIO: report['benchmark_averages'], report['overall_average'] and report['verdict'] pool across the three backbones.  They are SECONDARY.  The criterion is report['per_model'] / report['per_model_verdict'].
